fullDescription: A luxury 'Dossier' style design system characterized by a high-contrast Navy (#050B1A) and Gold (#C5A059) palette. It features a sophisticated pairing of editorial Serif typography (Zodiak) with a modern geometric Sans-serif (Satoshi). This aesthetic is ideal for high-end professional portfolios, luxury fintech, executive branding, or premium architecture firms. The layout utilizes generous whitespace, minimalist 1px borders, and subtle glow effects to create a sense of exclusivity and precision.
prompt:
## Resumo
A premium dark-mode design system using navy and gold accents with a focus on editorial typography and minimal line-based UI elements. The design emphasizes professional authority through wide-tracked uppercase labels and clean, geometric structures.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a background of #050B1A (Navy). Primary accent color is #C5A059 (Gold), and secondary text is #94A3B8 (Slate-400). Typography: Use 'Zodiak' Serif for H1-H3 headings with a tracking of -0.02em; use 'Satoshi' Sans-serif for body and navigational elements. For utility text (labels, sub-headers), use all-caps with extreme tracking (0.3em to 0.5em). Borders should be thin (1px) using white/5 or gold/20 opacity. Interactive elements should use a 0.3s ease-in-out transition. Hover states on cards should trigger a 'gold-glow' using box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(197, 160, 89, 0.15). Images should be grayscale or high-contrast with low opacity (0.6-0.8) and scale up slightly (1.05x) on hover.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed top navigation with a blur effect (backdrop-filter: blur(16px)) and a background of rgba(5, 11, 26, 0.8). Include a square logo box (40px) with 1px gold border. Links should be 13px, uppercase, tracking-widest, with a primary CTA button featuring a 1px gold border and transition to solid gold on hover.

### Hero Section
Full-height (100vh) hero with a subtle gold gradient bleed on the right. Large Serif H1 (96px) with intentional italicized words in gold. Subtext in 20px Sans-serif light weight. Primary CTA is a large solid gold block button with bold uppercase text and tracking-widest.

### Project/Feature Grid
Two-column staggered grid. Cards should have an aspect-ratio of 4:3 with a 1px border. Use a gradient overlay (bottom-to-top) from #050B1A to transparent. Text inside cards should include small gold labels in 10px uppercase tracking-widest.

### Persona/About Section
A two-column layout. Left side: grayscale portrait with a decorative gold-bordered frame and a floating stat box (Gold background, navy text) offset at the bottom-right. Right side: Serif H2 heading with gold accents, followed by two-column lists of features with uppercase gold subheads and bulleted points.

### Expertise/Skills Section
Four-column grid. Each column has a gold uppercase header. Use 'Minimalist Bars': a 1px height track (white/5) with a 1px height progress indicator (gold) and small percentage labels in 11px uppercase. Include a 'Tag Cloud' column where tags are 9px, uppercase, with 1px borders that highlight to gold on hover.

### Testimonials
Three-column grid where each item is separated by a 30% opacity gold left-border (not a full box). Quotes use Serif font, italicized, with a large muted gold quote icon at the top.

### Contact/Inquiry Section
Split layout. Left: informational text with large circular icons (gold border, 64px). Right: A dark card with a subtle 1px gold/10 border. Form fields should be 'line-only' (border-bottom only) with 10px bold uppercase labels and high-contrast placeholder text.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Line-Draw Link — An elegant text link with an animated underline.
Text link with uppercase tracking-widest. Underneath, a 1px gold line starts at 40px width and expands to 100% on hover using a 0.3s ease transition.

### The Logo Box — A minimalist square branding element.
A 40px x 40px square with a 1px #C5A059 border. Center a Serif bold initials/monogram. On hover, the background fills with #C5A059 and the text color flips to #050B1A.

### Gold-Border Tags — Minimalist labels for categorization.
9px font size, uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], weight-bold. Padding: 6px 12px. Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1). On hover, border-color changes to gold and text color shifts to gold.

style.description: The style is built on a foundation of 'Luxury Minimalist'. Typography pairs 'Zodiak' (Serif) for headings to provide a timeless, authoritative feel, with 'Satoshi' (Sans-serif) for body copy to ensure modern readability. The color palette is strictly limited to Deep Navy (#050B1A), vibrant Gold (#C5A059), and muted Slate grays (#F8FAFC, #94A3B8). Micro-interactions focus on smooth transitions (500ms-1000ms), 1px line drawing animations, and subtle scaling or glows rather than bouncy movements.
